rows.text: The two inference phases are **prompt processing** and **token-by-token generation**
rows.label: unsloth-ud

rows.text: Prompt processing (prefill) is compute-bound because it processes a large batch of tokens in parallel, allowing the GPU to fully utilize its tensor cores for matrix multiplications. In contrast, autoregressive decoding is memory-bound because it generates tokens sequentially, requiring the model's weights and the growing key-value cache to be loaded from high-bandwidth memory for every single token, which saturates memory bandwidth before the compute units can be fully utilized.
rows.label: unsloth-ud
